title: RADD shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the RADD dictionary file schemas.

description.description: What this is and why it exists, in plain language. Required by lint (RADD401): descriptions are what make the dictionary useful to people and AI agents.

tags.description: Free-form classification tags. Well-known tags: pii (personal data), financial, audit. Values of fields tagged pii or financial are never logged.

logicalType.description: Logical type. Each database adapter maps it to a native type; never use database types here.

severity.description: error: the save is rejected. warning: the save is rejected until the client resubmits with the code acknowledged. info: advisory; the save proceeds.

messageKey.description: A message key resolved from i18n/, for example customer.vipNotes.recommended.

code.description: Stable result code returned by validation and used to acknowledge warnings. Defaults to the message key.

expression.description: A CEL expression. Fields are referenced by their logical name; ctx holds server-supplied values such as ctx.today, ctx.now and ctx.locale.

dbName.description: Name in the database. Defaults to the TitleCase form of the logical name (countryCode becomes CountryCode). Override only to match an existing schema.

apiName.description: Name in the API (JSON properties and /_radd route segments). Defaults to the camelCase form of the logical name.

duration.description: A duration: a positive whole number followed by s, m, h or d, for example 10m.

parameter.description: A parameter accepted by a named validator or calculator.

required.description: Whether every use must supply this parameter.

default.description: Default value. A literal of the field's type, or { expression: "..." } for a computed default such as newGuid() or ctx.now.

rule.description: A conditional rule (when + required, readOnly or visible) or an expression rule (expression, optionally guarded by when).

when.description: Condition under which the rule applies (CEL).

required.description: Conditional: the field is required while when is true.

readOnly.description: Conditional: the field is read-only while when is true.

visible.description: Conditional UI hint: the field is visible while when is true.

expression.description: Expression rule: a boolean CEL expression that must be true, for example endDate >= startDate.

message.description: Message key for the result. Must exist in the default locale.

validatorUse.description: Use of a named server validator declared in validators.yaml.

name.description: Validator name as declared in validators.yaml.

message.description: Message key. Defaults to <entity>.<field>.<validatorName>, then the validator's declared message.

validators.description: Named server validators. They run only on the API.

lookup.description: Lookup: a static list ({ list: gender }) or a reference table ({ entity, value, display }). A reference-table lookup creates a foreign key.

list.description: Name of a static lookup in lookups/.

entity.description: Entity whose rows are the allowed values.

value.description: Field of the entity that is stored.

display.description: Field of the entity that is shown.

cache.description: static: loaded once per dictionary version. ttl: cached with an expiry. dynamic: queried on every use.

ttl.description: Expiry when cache is ttl. Defaults to lookups.defaultTtl in dictionary.yaml.

filter.description: Restricts the values offered and accepted. row is the candidate row, for example row.countryCode == countryCode.

dependsOn.description: Fields whose change re-filters this lookup.

search.description: Query by type-ahead instead of loading the whole table.

references.description: A plain foreign key to another entity.

field.description: Referenced field. Defaults to the entity's primary key.

onDelete.description: What happens to this row when the referenced row is deleted.

computed.description: Where a computed field's value comes from. Computed fields are always read-only.

source.description: database: a computed column. application: computed by the runtime from an expression or a named calculator.

sql.description: SQL per database provider (database source). Every enabled database needs an entry. Columns are referenced by dbName.

stored.description: Database source: stored (persisted) rather than virtual.

expression.description: Application source: CEL expression producing the value, for example dec.mul(quantity, unitPrice).

calculator.description: Application source: a named calculator declared in calculators.yaml.

persisted.description: Application source: store the value in a column (true) or compute it on read (false).

constraints.description: Constraint properties shared by fields and domain types.

pattern.description: Regular expression in RE2 syntax (no lookbehind or backreferences), for example ^09\d{9}$.
